text: The Sun contains about 99.86% of the mass in the solar system.
The Moon is about 1/4 the diameter of Earth, which is why lunar eclipses still cover the Sun from our view.
Light from the Sun takes about 8 minutes and 20 seconds to reach Earth.
Black holes aren't cosmic vacuum cleaners; objects need to get very close to be pulled in.
Space is nearly a perfect vacuum, which is why sound can't travel there.
The International Space Station travels around Earth approximately every 90 minutes.
A day on Mars (a 'sol') is about 24 hours and 39 minutes — very close to an Earth day.
The universe has been expanding since the Big Bang about 13.8 billion years ago.
